# CBDB-Desktop -- Entry Look At Entry label revisions 2026-10-27

CBDB-Desktop: Entry (Look At Entry) label revisions, 2026-10-27

Fourth form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAE). This version of the report is based on the **updated FormLabels (643 rows)** from the user's current CBDB database, which has 33 LAE rows; an earlier version of this report used a 330-row copy with 10. Changes are in the Entry form's index.html only. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom) to check every changed label in all three languages and the checkbox behaviour in ENT-1. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked. A copy of the file before any of these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html.

How to revert a label

All labels are in the T object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. To go back to the earlier wording, change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line has a comment naming its FormLabels row and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element; setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load, so editing T.english is enough.

Notes on individual changes

**LBL-26.** Colons kept because the labels precede input boxes. LAE 25 and 26 (From / To 始於 / 終於) belong to the Access dynasty range; the HTML's dynasty picker has no From / To, so they are not used.

**LBL-27.** LAE 3 has 類别 (traditional) with the simplified-form 别; 類別 is standard.

**LBL-31.** The four date-filter radio buttons now take the Access wording: No Dates (LAE 29), Use Index Years (LAE 14), Use Entry Year (LAE 17), Use Dynasties (LAE 30). This also replaces the 索引年 that CBDB-D-004 in the testing report flagged. LAE 15 (Use Dates 利用始終年) and LAE 28 (Years 入仕/指數年) have no counterpart in the HTML, which offers index and entry years as separate options.

**LBL-32. Store Person IDs.** LAE 20 has 存儲人物代碼 / 存储人物代码. The simplified label follows it. The traditional label uses 儲存 instead of 存儲, because 儲存 is the usual Taiwan term for storing and saving data (儲存檔案, 儲存空間), while 存储 is the usual mainland computing term (数据存储). This is the same regional split as 匯出 / 导出. If the table is to stay the master list, c_fanti should read 儲存人物代碼 in every Store Person IDs row. Revert to 存儲人物代碼 if the table's wording is preferred.

**LBL-33.** Select Place follows LAE 11 (選擇地名). The address **Clear** button becomes **All Places** (LAE 13, 所有地名): it removes the place filter, which is the same as selecting all places, and the Status form already labels its equivalent button All Places.

**LBL-34.** The Import and Save buttons read and write lists of entry codes. LAE 32 and 33 call them Import Entry (輸入入仕法) and Save Entry (保存入仕法). The table uses 輸入 for every Import button, and that was adopted. The Code label (代碼, no row) matches 人物代碼 (BIO 58).

**LBL-35.** The title in the HTML (CBDB — Look At Entry / 查看入仕途徑) and LAN 60 (查看社會網絡) both use 查看; the translation block used 瀏覽. Confirmed by the user.

**LBL-36.** LAE 16 has 顯示語言: with an ASCII colon. The full-width colon (：), used on every form so far, was kept.

**LBL-37.** btnSelectDynasty already had an id; a selectDynasties key and a setLanguage line were added. setLanguage already calls updateDynastyDisplay(), so the dynasty summary follows the language.

**LBL-38.** The link in the title bar got id="lnkNavigation", a navigation key in all three blocks, and a line in setLanguage that writes the arrow and the label ('← ' + t.navigation). 導航 / 导航 translates the English directly. LAE 10's 退出 ("Exit") was not used because the link returns to the navigation page rather than closing anything. To be applied to every form.

**LBL-46.** The Address type radio buttons take LAE 18 and 19. The table's English is abbreviated ("Use Person Addr", "Use Entry Addr"), presumably to fit the Access layout; it was written out in full. The Chinese 使用指數地址 makes clear that the person's address is the index address. **Data error:** LAE 18's c_fanti holds two lines, 使用指數地址 and 使用基本地址, separated by a stray carriage return (_x000d_); the first was used.

**LBL-47.** Include Subordinate Units (LAE 23, 含下轄行政區) settles the open question of 包含下級單位 vs 子單位. Use XY References is LAE 22 (singular "Reference" there; the other forms' rows say "References"). **Check the width of this row:** the two labels share one line, and "Include Subordinate Units" is much longer than "Include Sub-units".

**Comments.** A comment above T points to this report. A stale comment above handleAddressSelection was replaced with the actual callback shape.

ENT-1: Sub-units and Use XY

**Change.** Both checkboxes start disabled. handleAddressSelection enables them when the address picker returns a selection. **All Places** (clearAddress()) unticks and disables them, through a new helper, setAddrOptionsEnabled(enabled). This matches the Status, Texts and Associations forms (STA-2, TXT-2, ASC-1). Before this change, a box ticked before clearing the place stayed ticked, and the query sent addrSubUnits / addrUseXY with no addresses.

**Markup.** Each checkbox is now followed by &lt;label for=…&gt; instead of being inside a &lt;label&gt; with a &lt;span&gt;, so the global disabled-label rule (CSS-1) greys the text. The ids lblSubUnits and lblUseXY moved to the &lt;label&gt;s. chk-sep is now on a &lt;span&gt; wrapping the Use XY checkbox and label.

**jsdom check.** On load both boxes are disabled; after an address is picked they are enabled; after ticking both and clicking All Places they are unticked and disabled.

Entry Selection (入仕途徑選擇), Description (描述), Clear (entry), Address Filter, Address type, Date Filter, Export Query Results (匯出查詢結果 / 导出查询结果), KML, and the tab names Entries (入仕記錄) and People (人物). The user confirmed the page title and the tab names on 2026-10-27.

Issues

1. **Description label.** The HTML element says "Desc:" but T.english.desc is "Description:", which setLanguage writes on load. Check that it doesn't crowd its box.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed English and Chinese, as on the other query forms. If translated later, the SEN rows (Exam Rank 科第名次 SEN 18, Kin Name 親戚姓名 SEN 5, Associate 社會關係人 SEN 7, Place 入仕地名 SEN 20) are the obvious sources.
1. **Untranslated text.** The placeholders ([All], (none), year), "[Imported List]", "(multi)", "[N codes]", "No results yet…", the overlay, status, success and error messages, and sort tooltips are English only.
1. **Address-picker labels.** handleAddressSelection still builds the [All Filtered] / [Multi-select] labels itself; the address-picker plan of 2026-10-06 is still open.
